scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Go and train yourself in preparation for the holy war that is coming. Victory will be in the hands of those who are most ready to receive it.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
去修炼吧，为即将到来的圣战做好准备。胜利将属于那些最准备好迎接它的人。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We are Crusaders,
warriors preparing
to fight in the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我们是十字军，
是为圣战
做准备的战士。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah...
I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊……
我看你已被召唤成为十字军。我们确信你的意志，但现在我们必须测试你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We are Crusaders, warriors preparing for the Holy War.
What brings you
to this place?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我们是十字军，是为圣战做准备的战士。
是什么风把你
吹到这里来的？

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Have you proven your determination with the task I have given you, or do you possess the items proving that you have received your calling?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你是否通过我交给你的任务证明了你的决心，或者你拥有证明你已接受召唤的物品？

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你还没有完成作为剑士的所有学习。用完你剩余的所有技能点，然后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Congratulations on completing all of your tests. You are truly worthy of fighting alongside side us in the Holy War as a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
恭喜你完成了所有测试。你确实有资格作为十字军与我们并肩参加圣战。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
It seems that you have not yet completed all of the testing. You will not be ready to become a Crusader until you have completed the tests set before you.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
看来你还没有完成所有的测试。在你完成摆在你面前的测试之前，你还不能成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You don't belong here, my friend.
Be advised to continue practicing yourself.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我的朋友，你不属于这里。
建议你继续磨练自己。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Chaos will one day arise to challenge our principles of peace, justice and order. Until we have eliminated evil and created our ideal world, we must not cease training.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
混沌终有一天会崛起，挑战我们和平、正义和秩序的原则。在我们消灭邪恶并创造理想世界之前，我们绝不能停止训练。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you wish to join us, you must first learn the Swordsman discipline and train yourself thoroughly...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
如果你想加入我们，你必须先学习剑士的纪律并彻底磨练自己……

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
As it happened one thousand years ago, evil forces will one day attack in droves in an attempt to take over the world once again.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
正如一千年前发生的那样，邪恶势力终有一天会成群结队地攻击，试图再次占领世界。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
去普隆德拉王宫地下城中训练的穆尔纳克·米茹尔那里。去吧，先和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克和其他像他一样的人会测试你能力的极限，并帮助你找到你的道路。完成他们的测试后回到我这里……

scripts.text: I want to prepare for the Holy War!
scripts.translation: 我想为圣战做准备！

scripts.text: Nothing in particular.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You wish to become
a Crusader...?
Joining us is not as
easy as it sounds.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你想成为
十字军……？
加入我们并不像
听起来那么容易。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
I am Michael Halig. I am one of but many Crusaders preparing for the Holy War. We continuously train ourselves with sincere faith and endless loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我是迈克尔·哈利格。我是众多为圣战做准备的十字军之一。我们以真诚的信念和无尽的忠诚不断磨练自己。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
We recruit Swordsmen that express exceptional faith, or those who were born as warriors
by Odin's will.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
我们招募表现出非凡信仰的剑士，或是那些因奥丁的意志而生为战士的人。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Possessing the ^3355FFChivalry Emblem^000000 and ^3355FFHand of God^000000 is seen as a sign that you have been called to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
拥有 ^3355FF忠诚之证^000000 和 ^3355FF神之手^000000 被视为你被召唤成为十字军的标志。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
After obtaining those items and passing our tests, you too, can become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
获得这些物品并通过我们的测试后，你也可以成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
I don't know what type of person you are right now though. But
I shall test you if you desire. Are you willing to endure these tests in preparation for the Holy War?
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
虽然我不知道你现在是什么样的人。但如果你愿意，我会测试你。你愿意忍受这些为圣战做准备的测试吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有。

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it.
scripts.translation: 我想再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Wait...
You're not ready yet.
You need to be at least
Job Level 40 to become
a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
等等……
你还没准备好。
你需要至少达到
职业等级 40 才能成为
十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Train yourself more as a Swordsman and wait for your calling. I understand your intent, but as of now, you cannot join us.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
作为剑士更多地磨练自己，等待你的召唤。我理解你的意图，但目前你还不能加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
You haven't finished learning everything as a Swordsman. Use all of your remaining skill points, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你还没有完成作为剑士的所有学习。用完你剩余的所有技能点，然后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Then...
I shall test you to see if you are fit to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
那么……
我将测试你是否适合成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Your name is
{0}...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
你的名字是
{0}……？
让我看看……

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah...
I see that you have been called to become a Crusader. We are assured of your will, but now we must test your capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊……
我看你已被召唤成为十字军。我们确信你的意志，但现在我们必须测试你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
去普隆德拉王宫地下城中训练的穆尔纳克·米茹尔那里。去吧，先和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克和其他像他一样的人会测试你能力的极限，并帮助你找到你的道路。完成他们的测试后回到我这里……

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Mmm. I can't discern whether or not you have the heart to become a Crusader. However, if you have the will and put forth the effort, you may have what it takes.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
嗯。我无法分辨你是否有成为十字军的心。但是，如果你有这个意志并付出努力，你可能具备所需的条件。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now...
This is my test for you. Bring me the following items and prove your determination to me.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
现在……
这是我给你的测试。把以下物品带给我，向我证明你的决心。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Show me the strength of your will by gathering these items. If you prove successful, you will progress to the next test. May Odin protect you.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
通过收集这些物品来展示你意志的力量。如果你成功了，你将进入下一个测试。愿奥丁保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Nobody knows when the Holy War will come. We must prepare in advance and cannot afford to slacken
our training.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
没人知道圣战何时会到来。我们必须提前准备，不能松懈
我们的训练。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you feel that participating in the Holy War is your calling, please come back right away and take the test to become
a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
如果你觉得参加圣战是你的使命，请立刻回来参加成为
十字军的测试。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you, too, are a man of the sword, constantly train and prepare yourself. No one knows when the Holy War may begin.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
如果你也是持剑之人，请不断训练并做好准备。没人知道圣战何时开始。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
As a woman of the sword, you must train diligently and constantly. Prepare yourself, for no one knows when the Holy War may be coming.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
作为持剑之女，你必须勤奋且不断地训练。做好准备，因为没人知道圣战何时会到来。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah, well done.
I must acknowledge your efforts and determination. You may now proceed to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊，做得好。
我必须承认你的努力和决心。你现在可以继续进行下一个测试了。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Meet with Moorenak Miyol who is training in the underground dungeon of the Prontera Castle. Go, and speak with him first.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
去普隆德拉王宫地下城中训练的穆尔纳克·米茹尔那里。去吧，先和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Moorenak and others like him will test the limits of your capabilities and help you find your path. Return to me after you have completed their tests...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
穆尔纳克和其他像他一样的人会测试你能力的极限，并帮助你找到你的道路。完成他们的测试后回到我这里……

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Ah, you still have not completed the task I have given to you. Bring me the following items, and prove your will to become a Crusader to me...
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
啊，你还没有完成我交给你的任务。把以下物品带给我，向我证明你成为十字军的意志……

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
If you put forth the effort, you'll be able to accomplish this task. May Odin protect you on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
如果你付出努力，你就能完成这项任务。愿奥丁在你的旅途中保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Together, let us ready ourselves and be victorious over evil and tyranny!
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
让我们一起做好准备，战胜邪恶和暴政！

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Behold...!
You are now a Crusader!
When the Holy War comes, we shall fight side by side against the forces of evil.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
看吧……！
你现在是十字军了！
当圣战来临时，我们将并肩作战，对抗邪恶势力。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now you are
one of us!
...Brother.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
现在你是
我们的一员了！
……兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Now you are
one of us!
...Comrade.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
现在你是
我们的一员了！
……同志。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
And use this in times of dire peril. It will give you strength when your wounds are most grievous.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
在极度危险的时候使用这个。当你伤势最重时，它会给你力量。

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Never forget that the Holy War is approaching. We must be prepare for the inevitable tide of evil that will sweep this world. Now, go forth and fight for the principles of freedom and justice!
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
永远不要忘记圣战正在逼近。我们必须为席卷这个世界的不可避免的邪恶浪潮做好准备。现在，去吧，为自由和正义的原则而战！

scripts.text:
[Michael Halig]
Return to me when you have completed all of your tests. When you finally prove eligible, you will join the proud ranks of the mighty Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[迈克尔·哈利格]
当你完成所有测试后回到我这里。当你最终证明合格时，你将加入强大的十字军的光荣行列。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Don't linger around in a place like this and forge your own path towards discovering your own strengths. The day that we will join hands in battle will come soon.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
不要在这种地方逗留，开辟你自己的道路去发现你的力量。我们携手战斗的日子很快就会到来。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
A Novice...?
So green, and yet,
so much potential.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
初心者……？
如此青涩，然而，
潜力无限。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hm. You have no business in a place like this. Please leave, and do not interrupt my training.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
哼。你在这种地方没有事要做。请离开，不要打扰我的训练。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What do you want...?
If you have no business here,
then please leave. A tranquil state of mind is essential in self training...
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你想要什么……？
如果你在这里没事，
那就请离开。平静的心态对于自我训练至关重要……

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
Do you have business
with me, man of the sword?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
什么事……？
你有事找我吗，
持剑的男子？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
Do you have business
with me, woman of the sword?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
什么事……？
你有事找我吗，
持剑的女子？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
What is it...?
You're the Swordman from before. What happened, did you fail?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
什么事……？
你是之前的剑士。怎么了，失败了吗？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm, seems like you did well. It shouldn't have been too hard. You no longer have any business
with me.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯，看来你做得不错。应该不太难。你和我已经没有关系了。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmmm...
You still have tests to complete if you want to become a Crusader, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯……
如果你想成为十字军，还有测试要完成，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Let me assure you that I'm no criminal. I'm here merely to train myself. Perhaps as you become stronger, you will understand.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
让我向你保证我不是罪犯。我在这里只是为了磨练自己。也许当你变强时，你会明白。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I wish to improve the sense of serenity in my heart in preparation for the Holy War that is to come. So please, do not disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
我希望提高我内心的宁静感，为即将到来的圣战做准备。所以，请不要打扰我。

scripts.text: I'd like to take the Crusader test.
scripts.translation: 我想参加十字军测试。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You wish to become a Crusader...? Hm, fighting in the Holy War is an admirable goal we may both share.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你想成为十字军……？哼，在圣战中战斗是我们可能共同拥有的崇高目标。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Your name is
{0}...?
Let me take
a look at your face.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你的名字是
{0}……？
让我看看
你的脸。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm. You wish to become a Crusader, but do not wear a Rosary? I have no business with you if you cannot uphold our customs.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯。你想成为十字军，但不戴念珠？如果你不能遵守我们的习俗，我和你无话可说。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Hmm...
You seem so-so, but also young and ambitious. Ambition may work against you if it is not tempered with patience.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
嗯……
你看起来马马虎虎，但也年轻且有野心。如果野心没有耐心来调和，可能会对你不利。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Don't give me a reason to doubt you, and show me your patience. You must endure my test with your patience if you wish to become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
别给我怀疑你的理由，向我展示你的耐心。如果你想成为十字军，你必须用耐心忍受我的测试。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You may take my test right away. It's actually quite simple. All you must do is walk to the end of the corridor.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你可以马上参加我的测试。其实很简单。你只需要走到走廊的尽头。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
But...
You must keep one thing in mind. Under no condition are you allowed to kill the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
但是……
你必须记住一件事。在任何情况下都不允许杀死魔物。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Well then...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
那么……
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
You seem to have a lot of time on your hands. Why don't you do something more productive, like pick Jellopy off the streets or something?
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你似乎有很多空闲时间。为什么不做些更有成效的事情，比如从街上捡杰勒比结晶之类的？

scripts.text: Let me retake the test.
scripts.translation: 让我重考测试。

scripts.text: What kind of test was that?!
scripts.translation: 那是什么样的测试？！

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
I'll let you retake the test as much as you like. But if you continuously fail, there's an inherent problem with your
state of mind.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
我可以让你随意重考测试。但如果你连续失败，说明你的心态存在根本问题。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Wait...
Where have you left your Rosary? You can't let that lie around just anywhere. We are supposed to be warriors of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
等等……
你把念珠忘在哪里了？你不能把它随便乱放。我们应该是神圣的战士。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Carelessly losing things is an attitude for mere Swordsmen. If you really want to retake the test, you must respect the Crusader traditions.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
粗心大意地丢失物品只是剑士的态度。如果你真的想重考，你必须尊重十字军的传统。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Your problem is your habit of hitting monsters the moment you see one. You must develop your patience and endurance.
scripts.translation:
[穆尔纳克·米茹尔]
你的问题是一看到魔物就动手的习惯。你必须培养你的耐心和耐力。

scripts.text:
[Murnak Mijoul]
Just focus...
Your only goal is to walk from one end of the corridor to the other. It's simple when you think
about it.
scripts.translation:

好吧，首先让我
看看你的结果。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Superb! Now, it's time for
you to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
 {0}的得分
是 {1}分……
太棒了！现在，是你
参加下一个测试的时候了。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Well done~ Now, it's time for
you to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
 {0}的得分
是 {1}分……
做得好~ 现在，是你
参加下一个测试的时候了。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Seems like you prepared a lot so I'll let you pass this time.
Hurry now and go take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
 {0}的得分
是 {1}分……
看来你准备了很多，所以这次我就让你通过吧。
快点去参加下一个测试。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
 {0}'s score
is {1} points...
Hmmm... What a pity.
Go study some more and
take this test again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
 {0}的得分
是 {1}分……
嗯……真可惜。
再去学习一下，
然后重考这个测试，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to Prontera Castle
and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him that
he will be testing you next.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
去普隆德拉王宫
见布莱恩特·皮约德。
我会通知他
接下来由他测试你。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to Prontera Castle
and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him that
he will be testing you next.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
去普隆德拉王宫
见布莱恩特·皮约德。
我会通知他
接下来由他测试你。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Go to the Prontera Castle and meet Bliant Piyord.
I will inform him to prepare the next test.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
去普隆德拉王宫见布莱恩特·皮约德。
我会通知他准备下一个测试。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Don't stress, you need to know a lot in order to pass this test. In any case, I'll be waiting right here. When you think you're ready, come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
别紧张，你需要知道很多才能通过这个测试。无论如何，我就在这里等着。当你觉得准备好了，就回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
You will soon join us in our preparations for the Holy War. Continue to live with faith after becoming a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
你很快就会加入我们为圣战做的准备中。成为十字军后，继续怀着信仰生活。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel Valentine]
Finish those other tests,
and come to me once you're
instructed. Until then,
I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔·瓦伦丁]
完成其他那些测试，
接到指示后再来找我。在那之前，
回头见~

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
How goes
your training?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
你的训练
进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
We are Crusaders,
warriors of holiness preparing for the great Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
我们是十字军，
是为即将到来的伟大圣战做准备的神圣战士。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
It's nice
to meet you.
It is now time
for your final test.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
很高兴
见到你。
现在是
你最后测试的时间了。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Are you prepared
for the test now?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
你现在准备好
进行测试了吗？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Congratulations.
You have completed
all the tests to
become a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
恭喜。
你已经完成了
成为十字军的
所有测试。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
Are you not one of the ones in the process of becoming a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
你不是正在成为十字军过程中的人之一吗？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Develop your faith. From faith springs strength and discipline. Day after day, train yourself and become a great Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
培养你的信仰。力量源于信仰和纪律。日复一日，磨练自己，成为一名伟大的十字军。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Are you interested
in becoming a Crusader?
We are always waiting
for more capable men and
women to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
你有兴趣
成为十字军吗？
我们一直在等待
更多有能力的男女
加入我们的行列。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Train as a Swordsman and come to us when you think you are ready. If you have been called by Odin to become a Crusader, that would be even better.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
作为剑士进行训练，当你认为准备好时来找我们。如果你是被奥丁召唤成为十字军的，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Even in these relatively peaceful times, our training is ceaseless. We must be ready for the day with the tides of darkness shall rush against mankind...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
即使在这些相对和平的时代，我们的训练也从未停止。我们必须为黑暗浪潮冲击人类的那一天做好准备……

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Are you interested
in becoming a Crusader?
We are always waiting
for more capable men and
women to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
你有兴趣
成为十字军吗？
我们一直在等待
更多有能力的男女
加入我们的行列。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
To become a Crusader, you must train until you are Job Level 40. For more details, please speak with our leader inside.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
要成为十字军，你必须训练到职业等级 40。更多详情，请与里面的首领交谈。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
May Odin
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
愿奥丁
与你同在……

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
My name is Bliant Piyord and I too, am preparing for the Holy War. It must've been quite a hassle to come all this way.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
我叫布莱恩特·皮约德，我也在为圣战做准备。大老远跑来这里一定很麻烦吧。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
This test will gauge your skills in battle. Only those with great fighting ability can become Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
这项测试将评估你的战斗技能。只有具有强大战斗能力的人才能成为十字军。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
To take the battle test, bring
1 ^3355FFHoly Water^000000. This will be used to purify you prior to taking the test.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
要进行战斗测试，请带来
1 ^3355FF圣水^000000。这将用于在测试前净化你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Well then...
Shall we
begin right away?
Or do you need time
to prepare yourself?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
那么……
我们要
马上开始吗？
还是你需要时间
做准备？

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Would you like to begin now, or do you still need time to make preparations?
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
你想现在开始，还是需要时间做准备？

scripts.text: I would like to begin.
scripts.translation: 我想开始。

scripts.text: Give me some time to prepare.
scripts.translation: 给我点时间准备。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Just a second, you do not have a Rosary equipped. As a Crusader, you must always have a Rosary on your person.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
等一下，你没有装备念珠。作为十字军，你必须随身携带念珠。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Come back and take
the test after you
have a Rosary.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
等你有了念珠
再回来参加
测试。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
For the battle test, please prepare one ^3355FFHoly water^000000.
I told you just to purify the candidates.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
对于战斗测试，请准备一瓶 ^3355FF圣水^000000。
我说过这只是用来净化候选人的。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Get prepares and come back to here.
I will wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
做好准备再回来。
我会等你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Then, I'll start
the test. You will
be purified with the
Holy Water you prepared.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
那么，我开始
测试了。你将
用你准备的
圣水进行净化。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
...............
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
……………

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Let's begin.
Go and enter
the waiting room.
Defeat the monsters
that appear in
the 4 stages.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
开始吧。
进去
等候室。
击败在
4个阶段中
出现的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Prepare 1 ^3355FFHoly Water^000000 to take the battle test. As I've said, it will be used to purify you prior to taking the test.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
准备1瓶 ^3355FF圣水^000000 来参加战斗测试。如我所说，它将用于在测试前净化你。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Come back and take
the test after you
have prepared
1 Holy Water.
I shall be
waiting.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
准备好
1瓶圣水后
回来参加
测试。
我会
等着。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Go talk to our
leader inside.
We welcome you into
the ranks of those
preparing for the
coming Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
去和里面的
首领谈谈。
我们欢迎你加入
为即将到来的
圣战做准备的
行列。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
It's not your turn
to take my test yet.
Come back after taking
all the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
现在还不是
你参加我测试的时候。
完成所有其他测试
后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
I'll see you soon.
May Odin's blessings
be with you.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
很快再见。
愿奥丁的祝福
与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Welcome.
You will take
the last test here.
If you are ready for
the test, enter the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
欢迎。
你将在这里参加
最后的测试。
如果你准备好
进行测试，请进入
等候室。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Only one person can take the test at a time. If someone else is already testing, please wait until the testing area is made available once again.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
一次只能有一人参加测试。如果其他人已经在测试，请等待测试区域再次可用。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Each person will get 4 minutes to complete the test. If you wish to leave in the middle of the test, please disconnect from the game.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
每人将有4分钟完成测试。如果你想在测试中途离开，请断开游戏连接。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
Go forth and defeat all
the monsters that appear.
You will not pass if any
are remaining.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
前去击败所有
出现的魔物。
如果有任何残留，
你将无法通过。

scripts.text:
[Bliant Piyord]
You will be given
4 minutes. Go forth
and do your best...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩特·皮约德]
你将获得
4分钟。前去
尽力而为……
